i1.title: Antonio Banderas Blue Seduction for Women Eau de Toilette 80ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A fresh, fruity floral full of light and energy.

Antonio Banderas Blue Seduction for Women Eau de Toilette 80ml is a fresh fruity floral first launched in 2008. Melon, bergamot, pear and violet leaf open brightly, a floral heart of Bulgarian rose, gardenia, jasmine, lily of the valley and peony follows, and it settles on raspberry, patchouli, musk and benzoin.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Melon, Bergamot, Pear, Violet Leaf
  • Heart: Bulgarian Rose, Gardenia, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley, Peony
  • Base: Raspberry, Patchouli, Musk, Benzoin

Key details

  • Brand: Antonio Banderas
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 80ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Fresh
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy opening of melon and pear
  • A rich floral heart of rose, gardenia and jasmine
  • A soft base of raspberry, musk and benzoin
  • Fresh and easy to wear every day

FAQ

What does Blue Seduction for Women smell like?

Melon, bergamot, pear and violet leaf first, then Bulgarian rose, gardenia, jasmine, lily of the valley and peony, finishing with raspberry, patchouli, musk and benzoin.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
